resources.string:
Authors: Vladimir Sosa, Muhammad Mutto, Abisan Vijayakaran
Activity Version: Version 1.0 (Build 1)

How to Use the Interface: 
• Home (Translator): Tap Start Camera to recognize live ASL handshapes, or type/speak via Microphone to convert English text into ASL fingerspelling cards.
• Add Bookmark (+): Tap the + button in the bottom bar to save the current phrase to the SQLite database.
• Dictionary / Bookmarks: View saved phrases in the RecyclerView, tap any item to view its detailed fingerspelling breakdown, or tap the trash icon to delete it.
• Recents: View or clear your recent translation history.
• Drawer & Settings: Open the top-left menu or Settings tab to edit your profile, switch app languages, toggle dark mode, or log out.

ASL Translator
CP470 Term Project: An American Sign Language live translation app
